|lore=Sand People use a special mask to reclaim exhaled moisture in the hot, harsh environment of Tatooine. Protects by filtering blowing sand and dispersing excess heat.
|game_text=Deploy on an exterior Tatooine battleground site. X = the face-up destiny number of your Objective. Once per turn, if all your ability on table is provided by aliens, your total ability during battle at a site is +X. This Effect canceled if opponent controls this site.

The known earlier full card moves the Effect to table, narrows the all-ability test to aliens, and makes the ability increase or damage protection a choice. The 17 September 2007 slip restores site placement and opposing control cancellation, specifies the exterior Tatooine battleground and keeps only an ability modifier for site battle. The historical V17 alternate says may add. The official slip and current full reconstruction print is +X. [https://web.archive.org/web/20071203110550id_/http://www.swccgpc.com/cards/v8/ls/tuskenbreathmask.gif Exact issuer gallery capture].
